project_type: Next.js 16.2.10 App Router with React 19.2.4, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: npm with Next.js build system, no Docker
test_framework: Jest/testing-library (85 tests passing), test files in __tests__/ and *.test.ts
verification_instructions: Run: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test
environment_constraints: No content/metadata/imported-questions/ directory in sandbox (only on user's machine). Test code changes via tsc and lint only. GitHub power for pushing.
contribution_requirements: Never use useSyncExternalStore for localStorage. Never call router.push() during render. Use useState(() => ...) for lazy init. Use sortByCfaOrder from shared/config/subjects.ts. Run tsc + lint before commit.
key_patterns: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). CSS variables for theming (var(--foreground), var(--card-bg), etc.). localStorage for all user data. API routes in src/app/api/. loadAllQuestions() merges sample + imported questions from localStorage. useImportedQuestions hook in src/features/question-bank/hooks/useImportedQuestions.ts auto-fetches on first visit.
directory_structure: src/app/ (routes), src/features/ (19 feature modules), src/shared/ (cross-feature code), src/scripts/ (CLI tools), content/ (gitignored PDFs + metadata)
